### A Prayer to Remember God’s Faithfulness at Passover
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-remember-gods-faithfulness-at-passover-your-daily-prayer.html
Passage: Exodus 12:26-27
Points:
- God commanded Israel to commemorate the Passover as a lasting memorial of their deliverance from Egypt.
- The ceremony was designed so parents could answer their children's questions about God's saving power.
- The blood of the slaughtered lamb foreshadowed Jesus Christ as the true Lamb of God.
- Remembering Passover directs believers' hearts toward gratitude for Christ's sacrifice and resurrection.

### Passover - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: One Year Devotions for Men
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/passover-one-year-devotions-for-men-may-19.html
Passage: Exodus 12:26-27
Points:
- God instituted the Passover ritual to prompt children's curiosity and provide intentional teaching moments.
- The shedding of lamb's blood protected Israelite homes from judgment and prefigured the death of Jesus.
- Believers today find refuge from divine judgment solely through the sacrifice of Christ.
- Christian parents are challenged to establish meaningful family traditions that communicate the gospel to their children.

### Read the Bible: Exodus 12:21-51, Luke 15, Job 30, 1 Corinthians 16
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/exodus-1221-51-luke-15-job-30-1-corinthians-16/
Passage: Exodus 12:21-51
Points:
- Moses instructed the elders to apply lamb's blood so the destroyer would pass over their households.
- The Passover established a fundamental principle: guilty people are spared only when an innocent substitute dies.
- The feast was instituted as a perpetual statute so upcoming generations would know how God redeemed His people.
- The original Passover finds its ultimate fulfillment in Christ, our Passover Lamb, through the new covenant.

### What is the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the Bible?
Author: Tammy Kennington
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-feast-of-unleavened-bread-bible.html
Passage: Exodus 12:14
Points:
- God instituted the feast as an enduring memorial uniting active remembrance with worship.
- Eating unleavened bread recalled the haste of Israel's escape and their calling to remain distinct from Egypt.
- Biblical leaven symbolizes sin, reminding believers to purge sinful compromises from their lives and churches.
- Believers are invited to pause from worldly striving, rest in God's presence, and trust Christ the Deliverer.
